recipe.representatives: Existing introduction/uniform 4-or-8 recipe; ties to even.
recipe.lexical: Maximum unique-query-term corpus IDF weight of a line within a chunk; normalized by the maximum across the whole returned file.
recipe.fallback: No positive lexical match: selected passage start. Global control falls back to the strongest stored passage start.
recipe.ties: Earliest chunk, then earliest lexical line.
recipe.ranking: Fixed input candidate order and scores; bounded serialization can still change which trailing rows fit.

policy.cue: First single-line inline-backtick identifier/option, length3..80, outside fenced blocks; exact case-sensitive literal.
policy.reads: Ranked returned files/anchors only; center requested61-line window on the shown interval. File-only results begin at line1. Skip fully covered read intervals, clipped at EOF only when a previous read reported it.
policy.feedback: None. Returned/inspected does not imply usefulness or acceptance.
policy.stopping: Fixed schedule/limits only. Never use annotation overlap or success to stop.

provenance.coordinate_policy: Strict local UTF-8 bytes and physical LF lines; 0-based start_line/byte and exclusive end_byte, source-verified; no global byte coordinates.

provenance.condition: Frozen actual hybrid candidate order/scores; source-only evidence selection, shared real Rust bridge preparation, actual fresh Ixos read/grep follow-ups. Initial original diagnostics tokens charged equally as a frozen reference. Only follow-up tool wall time is reported; no production search latency claim.
provenance.limitations: Repository-family development/validation supplied-source descriptions and strict local coordinate audits; generated semantic labels inherited, unknown pretraining overlap. Fixed schedule, no LLM reasoning or success. No held-out/default promotion. Output fitting can change retained trailing candidates; file ranking metrics are rescored honestly.
